name: creatorflow-studio
description: A portable gated idea-to-video workflow with shared Flow and Cartesia providers across Antigravity, Codex, Cherry Studio, and local command hosts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a topic and vibe into a finished short video.
interface.longDescription: CreatorFlow Studio inventories past content, finds distinct ideas, creates an approval-ready production brief, then builds a voice-led Remotion video. It delays paid image and voice calls until approval and reuses cached assets whenever possible.
defaultPrompt: Topic: home coffee. Vibe: warm editorial.
Find fresh ideas for my channel without repeats.
Produce my approved brief and render the video.
